analytical_investigation_record.observation: The execution generated 1549 leads and 469 A/B leads; Tier A is small at 67 leads.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: Volume is substantial, but the highest-quality segment is limited.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: FARO tier is the authorized quality proxy; downstream revenue is not available.

analytical_investigation_record.observation: The commercial matched universe contains 1362 leads, 396 A/B leads and 1069.05 EUR commercial spend.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: Canonical cost-quality metrics are calculable only on matched coverage.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: Lead-only and spend-only coverage must not be read as zero-cost or zero-lead performance.

analytical_investigation_record.observation: Matched cost per A/B lead is 2.70 EUR and cpl_commercial_matched is 0.78 EUR.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: Economic efficiency is strong in the matched universe, but it is not a global CPL.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: Temporal spend evidence is partial and campaign/adset spend is derived via ad-level reconciliation.

analytical_investigation_record.observation: The strongest quality separator is ticket or ticket-like intent: tiene_billetes true has 89.45% A/B rate versus 20.59% when false.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: Lead quality is much more explained by intent status than by aggregate volume.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: This is an observed association, not a causal claim or a post-lead revenue outcome.

analytical_investigation_record.observation: The main captacion adset concentrates 1267 of 1549 leads and 929.52 EUR of matched commercial spend.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: The system is highly dependent on one acquisition structure for scale.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: Campaign/adset spend is derived from ad-level reconciliation due fct_spend schema.

analytical_investigation_record.observation: Some high-quality-looking lead-side groups, such as RTG/DIASPORA, are lead_only for commercial matched spend in this execution.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: Quality comparisons and economic comparisons are not equivalent when coverage differs.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: The absence of matched commercial spend does not prove zero investment or free acquisition.

analytical_investigation_record.observation: Monthly A/B quality is broadly stable around 29.5%-32.7%, with July partial data slightly higher.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: There is no strong deterioration signal in quality across the monthly lead-side view.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: April and July are partial months; weekly and temporal cost-quality are partial.

analytical_investigation_record.observation: Facebook contributes 1047 leads with 31.42% A/B rate; Instagram contributes 502 leads with 27.89% A/B rate.
analytical_investigation_record.importance: Platform differences exist but are moderate and remain associative.
analytical_investigation_record.uncertainty: Platform spend and placement-level economics were not available in this execution.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: AUC-001 is buying substantial Meta lead volume, but only about 30.28% of total leads are A/B and only 4.33% are Tier A.
knowledge_claims.business_implication: The decision problem is not lead availability; it is improving the mix of qualified and high-intent leads.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: FARO quality is the available quality standard; revenue conversion is not available.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: The matched commercial universe is economically efficient on observed metrics, with 0.78 EUR cpl_commercial_matched and 2.70 EUR cost_per_ab_commercial_matched.
knowledge_claims.business_implication: The current matched acquisition base is not obviously inefficient economically, so optimization should avoid reading generic CPL in isolation.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: This applies only to matched commercial coverage and excludes lead_only/spend_only interpretation.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Intent/status signals separate quality much more sharply than aggregate campaign volume: tiene_billetes true reaches 89.45% A/B and solo_mirando only 5.55% A/B.
knowledge_claims.business_implication: Future optimization should focus on increasing qualified intent signals, not merely more form submissions.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: The relationship is observational and must not be treated as causal or as revenue validation.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Volume and spend are concentrated in the main captacion structure and two high-volume ads.
knowledge_claims.business_implication: A small number of assets can dominate learning and reporting, creating dependency risk and possible overfitting to current messages.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Ad-level sample is sufficient for descriptive ranking, but creative causality remains UNKNOWN.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: DIASPORA/RTG and ticket-intent-aligned traffic may contain higher quality share, but coverage prevents a full economic comparison.
knowledge_claims.business_implication: There may be quality upside outside the dominant matched captacion base, but it is not yet safe to reallocate spend on this evidence alone.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Lead-only coverage and missing temporal spend make the economic claim partial.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Lead-side quality is stable month to month, with July partial data slightly stronger but not enough to claim a durable trend.
knowledge_claims.business_implication: There is no urgent evidence of quality collapse; optimization can be framed as improving mix rather than emergency correction.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Weekly comparability and temporal cost-quality remain partial.

analytical_narrative.text: El fenomeno principal es una tension entre escala eficiente y calidad selectiva: Meta esta generando mucho volumen a bajo coste observado en el universo comercial matched, pero la calidad alta se concentra en señales de intencion muy concretas y en una parte pequena del volumen. Los hallazgos estructurales son la dependencia del matched comercial, la concentracion de volumen en pocas estructuras y la separacion fuerte que produce tener billetes o estados equivalentes; los hallazgos secundarios son las diferencias moderadas por plataforma y la estabilidad mensual. El trade-off dominante es no sacrificar escala barata mientras se intenta desplazar el mix hacia señales de mayor intencion. La limitacion que mas condiciona la lectura es la cobertura: lead_only, spend_only y la falta de coste temporal impiden convertir todos los patrones de calidad en decisiones economicas. La implicacion estrategica es que VCA no necesita solo mas leads, necesita que Meta aprenda y sea evaluada por calidad observable. La idea que debe quedar una semana despues es: el coste parece controlado, pero el valor esta en mover el mix hacia intencion, no en celebrar volumen.

risks: Over-interpreting lead_only groups as zero-cost efficient.
Treating ad_name patterns as creative causality.
Using generic CPL/CPQL terminology without matched commercial universe.
Comparing partial weeks as complete weeks.
unknowns: Revenue conversion and sales outcome remain not_available.
